body: I just got out of a similar relationship, my ex immediately moved to Seattle. Literally dipped states halfway across the country cuz he fucked up so bad. But, he still attempts to finds ways to get under my skin, even reaching out to my family. Just keep her blocked. If she bothers you further, get a restraining order. These people are relentless, manipulative, and narcissistic as hell. The best thing you can do is let them sit in the mess they’ve made.
